content:
Overview

Winterthur is a city in Zurich with a population of 114,000. A charming city near Zurich known for its Technical University, extensive museums including the Technorama science center, and a beautifully preserved old town. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
